name: Disco del vespro
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL wide 16:9 full-page painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: An oppressive solar outpost in a dry white valley, rich gold standards above chained irrigation pipes; one enormous sun in the sky with a GOLD/ORANGE IRIS and DARK PUPIL exactly like Benedict's sun. Small exhausted travellers below. Gold, pale ochre, burnt orange and cold blue shadows. Composition: illustrate the whole page naturally, with a quiet darker centre for readable controls, no empty rectangular panels. Matte hand-painted gouache and restrained anime fantasy linework, attractive deliberate shapes, believable construction and materials, detailed but uncluttered, no glossy 3D. The first reference is ONLY for painterly technique; do NOT copy its objects, geography, sunset or lighting. Solar lore: the Sun is oppressive, except the heroic Benedict. If the sun is visible, match ONLY the gold-orange iris and dark pupil sun from the second reference, never its statue or city. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, no currency discs, no Obser, no engraved eyes as generic decorations. Any clouds present naturally in the scene mix luminous BLUE dominant, then INDIGO, VIOLET and PASTEL PINK. Do not force clouds indoors. Tell the story ONLY through image details. NO writing, text, UI, logos, watermarks. Do not repeat the previous theme's composition, relic or environment.
